---
title: "Micropip Test"
filters:
  - shinylive
---

This page tests whether a Shinylive app embedded in Quarto can install a Python
package using a bundled `requirements.txt` file.

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
## file: app.py
from pyfiglet import figlet_format
from shiny import App, ui

app = App(
    ui.page_fluid(
        ui.h2("requirements.txt install test"),
        ui.p("If this page works, the package was installed inside the Shinylive runtime."),
        ui.tags.pre(figlet_format("MCQPy")),
    ),
    None,
)

## file: requirements.txt
pyfiglet
```
